examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}はだめだった。
examples.english: It was no good this time.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}は{楽|たの}しかったです。
{今回|こんかい}の{仕事|しごと}は{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: The work this time was tough.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}は{行|い}けなかったけど、{今度|こんど}は{行|い}きたいと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I couldn't go this time, but I want to go next time.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}は{時間|じかん}がなくて{大変|たいへん}だったが、{次|つぎ}はもっとよくしたいと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: This time I didn't have enough time and it was hard, but I want to do better next time.

notes:
{今回|こんかい} means "this time" or "this occasion," often implying comparison with other times.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今回|こんかい}は〜: this time...
- {今回|こんかい}の〜: this (current) ...
- {今回|こんかい}で{何回目|なんかいめ}: which time is this?
- {今回|こんかい}に{限|かぎ}り: this time only

RELATED 〜{回|かい} WORDS:
- {前回|ぜんかい}: last time
- {次回|じかい}: next time
- {毎回|まいかい}: every time
- {初回|しょかい}: first time
- {今回|こんかい}: this time

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {今度|こんど}: this time, next time (ambiguous)
- {今回|こんかい}: this time (current occasion, clearer)

NOTE:
{今回|こんかい} is commonly used in news and formal contexts to refer to "the current case/incident."
